about: The carving layer of the Blender sources (D-306; tools/blender/lib/carving.ts): relief the photographs show on the capitals and the Gate's colossi that the project's SDF models lack. Map-only: added to the dense surface Blender bakes from, never to the game's triangles. Units: the model's (protome: D, the lower shaft diameter; colossus: metres in sculpture.json colossus.reference_box). Paths: [x, y] points are projected onto the flank from +z, [x, y, z] points snapped onto the surface. Tiers: the motifs (bead rows, collar band with rosettes, ridged mane, harness pendant) are photographed on the surviving capitals and doorway bulls, so their presence on these pieces is B; their layout and sizes are matched by eye on the photographs listed with each motif (C: no measured drawing of the carving was read; the ISAC Schmidt volumes' plates are the next source, Q-840). Sizes read by proportion to the model's own head and neck in the same photograph.

motifs.name: mane
motifs.note: the neck crest carved as rows of short tongue-shaped locks across the crest, from behind the ears to the withers (photographed on both capitals: B for the motif); band 0.26 D each side of the crest in 4 rows, locks 0.036 D apart, 0.016 D high (C, by proportion to the neck's height in cap_side: about a fifth of it)

motifs.name: halter
motifs.note: a double row of beads arching round the back of the head from behind the ear down to the throat (both photographs); beads 0.036 D across, rows 0.04 D apart (C)

motifs.name: collar
motifs.note: the collar: a flat strap with a bead row along each edge and twelve-petalled rosettes along its middle, from the chest (where the curl apron ends) round the neck base, rising back toward the withers (cap_side: the band of rosettes between bead rows on the lower neck); strap 0.12 D wide, rosettes 0.09 D across at 0.1 D (C)

motifs.name: pendant
motifs.note: the harness pendant: short bead rows hanging from the collar over the shoulder, longest in the middle (cap_side: the trapezoid of bead rows on the shoulder); 6 rows 0.036 D apart (C)

motifs.name: strap
motifs.note: a double bead row along the back from the collar to the middle of the block (cap_side: the beaded strap along each bull's back) (C)

motifs.name: belly
motifs.note: a double bead row along the lower edge of the body over the folded forelegs (cap_side: the beaded band above the legs, running the length of the body) (C)

mirror.note: the fore-part stands in the round: its far side carries the same carving, mirrored about the body plane z = colossus.body.zc

motifs.name: collar
motifs.note: a collar band of rosettes between bead rows round the top of the neck under the (lost) head (gate_bull: the ornamented band where the neck meets the head); 18 cm wide, rosettes 12 cm across (C)

motifs.name: mane
motifs.note: the neck crest as rows of short ridged locks, as on the bull capitals (gate_bull: the ribbed band along the top of the neck; worn) (C)

motifs.name: chest_edge
motifs.note: a double bead row along the back edge of the chest curl field, from the belly to the neck (gate_bull: the beaded rows framing the chest; gate_front: the same on the human-headed bulls); beads 5 cm across, rows 5 cm apart (C, by proportion to the 5.5 m figure)

motifs.name: belly_band
motifs.note: a bead row along the belly above the fringe of curls (gate_bull) (C)

motifs.name: chest_edge
motifs.note: a double bead row along the back edge of the chest curl field, from the belly to the neck (gate_bull: the beaded rows framing the chest; gate_front: the same on the human-headed bulls); beads 5 cm across, rows 5 cm apart (C, by proportion to the 5.5 m figure)

motifs.name: belly_band
motifs.note: a bead row along the belly above the fringe of curls (gate_bull) (C)

fields.name: barbs
fields.note: the barbs of the wing primaries: fine grooves along each feather (gate_front; the Assyrian and Achaemenid wing convention); 1.8 cm apart, 4 mm deep (C)

fields.name: crown_rosettes
fields.note: the petals of the rosettes on the tiara band (gate_front: rosettes on the crown) cut into the bosses of the model (C)

volute.fill_note: the roll ends are photographed as rosettes in a plain disc (B for the motif on this member), not the spiral channel of the model (D-151, C): the high source is the model with its channel filled (carve 0), the rosette carved on it; the game's pieces keep their spiral (Q-841)

rosette.note: rosette across 72 % of the roll's radius, 12 petals, 0.1 of the radius high; a rim at the disc's edge 12 % of the radius wide (by eye from the photograph)

rings.note: four raised rings round each roll's barrel, 4.4 cm·D wide (by eye: the photograph's barrels show 3-4 ribs)
